name: gavelhouse.com Thoroughbred 22 June 2026 auction
description: Please contact vendors and discuss the horse you are interested in before bidding. During the final countdown there is no benefit in letting the clock run down to the last second before bidding. The auction will just keep auto-extending and you also risk missing out if your internet connection has dropped out. gavelhouse.com cannot identify loss of online connection or browser issues at the user’s end. Even a slight loss of internet connection that may not be noticeable can interrupt the user’s browser in following the sale in real-time therefore setting up an auto-bid is the best way to ensure your bids are placed. Google Chrome or Safari are the recommended internet browsers.
